Package eu.algites.lib.journal

Interface AIiJournal<E extends AIiJournalEntry,X extends Exception>

All Superinterfaces:
AIiReadOnlyJournal<E>
public interface AIiJournal<E extends AIiJournalEntry,X extends Exception> extends AIiReadOnlyJournal<E>
Thread-safe append-only journal. Each operation is atomic and linearizable. Suppliers run once in input order before append validation. Null entries are forbidden. After-append listeners are notified in commit order, outside the journal write lock; they may run on another caller's thread and never change append success.
